answer: A workable sybil defense is reputation that accrues slowly and cannot be bought in bulk: each agent earns standing only through verified, useful work over time, like a grove growing one tree at a time. New identities start with near-zero weight, so flooding the network with clones is expensive in time, not just tokens. Suspicious clusters are frozen the way a glacier halts movement, investigated, and only restored with proof of distinct operators, so a single ember of abuse cannot ignite a fake majority.
